items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations. URL-based HandlerMappings will
typically support it, but handlers should not necessarily expect
this request attribute to be present in all scenarios.
items.translation: 注意：并非所有 `HandlerMapping` 实现都必须支持此属性。基于 URL 的 `HandlerMapping` 通常支持它，但处理器不应期望在所有场景下都存在此请求属性。

items.source: Whether this HandlerMapping instance has been enabled to use parsed PathPatterns in which case the DispatcherServlet automatically parses the RequestPath to make it available for access in HandlerMappings, HandlerInterceptors, and other components.
items.translation: 该 `HandlerMapping` 实例是否已启用以使用解析的PathPatterns，如果是，则DispatcherServlet会自动parsesRequestPath，以便在HandlerMappings、HandlerInterceptors 和其他组件中进行access。

items.source: HandlerMapping implementations can support mapped interceptors but do not have to. A handler will always be wrapped in a HandlerExecutionChain instance, optionally accompanied by some HandlerInterceptor instances. The DispatcherServlet will first call each HandlerInterceptor's preHandle method in the given order, finally invoking the handler itself if all preHandle methods have returned true.
items.translation: HandlerMapping 实现可以支持映射的拦截器，但并非必须。处理器始终会被包装在 `HandlerExecutionChain` 实例中，并可选地伴随一些 `HandlerInterceptor` 实例。DispatcherServlet 将首先按给定顺序调用每个 HandlerInterceptor 的`preHandle`方法，如果所有`preHandle`方法都返回了 `true`，则最终调用处理器本身。

items.source: This class can be implemented by application developers, although this is not necessary, as BeanNameUrlHandlerMapping and RequestMappingHandlerMapping are included in the framework. The former is the default if no HandlerMapping bean is registered in the application context.
items.translation: 该类可由应用程序开发人员实现，尽管这并非必须，因为 `BeanNameUrlHandlerMapping` 和 `RequestMappingHandlerMapping` 已包含在框架中。如果应用程序上下文中未注册任何 HandlerMapping Bean，前者将作为默认选项。

items.source: Note: Implementations can implement the Ordered interface to be able to specify a sorting order and thus a priority for getting applied by DispatcherServlet. Non-Ordered instances get treated as the lowest priority.
items.translation: 注意：实现可以实现在 Ordered 接口，以便指定排序顺序，从而确定由 DispatcherServlet 应用的优先级。非 Ordered 实例被视为最低优先级。

items.source: Returns null if no match was found. This is not an error. The DispatcherServlet will query all registered HandlerMapping beans to find a match, and only decide there is an error if none can find a handler.
items.translation: 如果未找到匹配项，则返回 null。这不是错误。DispatcherServlet 将查询所有已注册的 HandlerMapping Bean 以查找匹配项，并且仅在没有任何 Bean 找到处理器时才判定为错误。

items.source:
The ability to parameterize this mapping is a powerful and unusual
capability of this MVC framework. For example, it is possible to write
a custom mapping based on session state, cookie state or many other
variables. No other MVC framework seems to be equally flexible.
items.translation: 此映射的参数化能力是此 MVC 框架强大且独特的特性。例如，可以编写基于会话状态、Cookie 状态或许多其他变量的自定义映射。似乎没有其他 MVC 框架具有同等程度的灵活性。

items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations.
items.translation: 注意：此属性并非所有 HandlerMapping 实现都必须支持。

items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations and may also not be present depending on
whether the HandlerMapping is configured to keep matrix variable content
items.translation: 注意：此属性并非所有 `HandlerMapping` 实现都必须支持，并且根据 `HandlerMapping` 是否配置为保留矩阵变量内容，该属性也可能不存在。

items.source:
The returned HandlerExecutionChain contains a handler Object, rather than
even a tag interface, so that handlers are not constrained in any way.
For example, a HandlerAdapter could be written to allow another framework's
handler objects to be used.
items.translation: 返回的 `HandlerExecutionChain` 包含一个 `Handler` 对象，而不是任何标签接口，因此对处理器没有任何约束。例如，可以编写一个 `HandlerAdapter` 以允许使用其他框架的处理器对象。

items.source: in favor of UrlPathHelper.PATH_ATTRIBUTE and ServletRequestPathUtils.PATH_ATTRIBUTE. To access the cached path used for request mapping, use ServletRequestPathUtils.getCachedPathValue(ServletRequest).
items.translation: 支持使用 UrlPathHelper.PATH_ATTRIBUTE 和 ServletRequestPathUtils.PATH_ATTRIBUTE。 若要访问用于请求映射的缓存路径，请使用 ServletRequestPathUtils.getCachedPathValue(ServletRequest)。

items.source: in favor of UrlPathHelper.PATH_ATTRIBUTE and ServletRequestPathUtils.PATH_ATTRIBUTE.
items.translation: 支持使用 UrlPathHelper.PATH_ATTRIBUTE 和 ServletRequestPathUtils.PATH_ATTRIBUTE。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the path used to look up the matching handler, which depending on the configured UrlPathHelper could be the full path or without the context path, decoded or not, etc.
items.translation: 包含用于查找匹配处理器的路径的 HttpServletRequest 属性名称，该路径根据配置的UrlPathHelper可能是完整路径或不含上下文路径、已解码或未解码等。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the resolved and parsed API version.
items.translation: 包含已解析和解析的 API 版本的 HttpServletRequest 属性的名称。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the mapped handler for the best matching pattern.
items.translation: 包含最佳匹配模式映射处理器的 `HttpServletRequest` 属性名称。

items.source: a HandlerExecutionChain instance containing handler object and any interceptors, or null if no mapping found
items.translation: 包含处理器对象和任何拦截器的 HandlerExecutionChain 实例，或者如果未找到映射则为 `null`。

items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations. Handlers should not necessarily expect
this request attribute to be present in all scenarios.
items.translation: 注意：并非所有 HandlerMapping 实现都必须支持此属性。处理器不应期望在所有场景下都存在此请求属性。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the best matching pattern within the handler mapping.
items.translation: 包含处理器映射中最佳匹配模式的 HttpServletRequest 属性的名称。

items.source: Name of the boolean HttpServletRequest attribute that indicates whether type-level mappings should be inspected.
items.translation: 指示是否应检查类型级别映射的布尔 `HttpServletRequest` 属性名称。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains a map with URI variable names and a corresponding MultiValueMap of URI matrix variables for each.
items.translation: 包含具有 URI 变量名称和每个名称对应的 URI 矩阵变量的 MultiValueMap 的 `HttpServletRequest` 属性的名称。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the path within the handler mapping, in case of a pattern match, or the full relevant URI (typically within the DispatcherServlet's mapping) else.
items.translation: 包含处理器映射中路径（在模式匹配时）或完整相关 URI（通常在 DispatcherServlet 的映射内，否则）的 HttpServletRequest 属性名称。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the set of producible MediaTypes applicable to the mapped handler.
items.translation: 包含适用于已映射处理器的可生成 MediaType 集合的 `HttpServletRequest` 属性名称。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the URI templates map, mapping variable names to values.
items.translation: 包含 URI 模板映射（将变量名映射到值）的 `HttpServletRequest` 属性的名称。

items.source: Return a handler and any interceptors for this request.
items.translation: 返回此请求的处理程序和任何拦截器。

items.source: Exception - if there is an internal error
items.translation: Exception - 如果发生内部错误

items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求
